verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is an infrastructure-as-code tool, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair thing to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or any first-party agent connection endpoint. The pack only covers the CLI, state encryption, testing and installation, and the probes show no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
